text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between Fulham and Nottingham Forest at Craven Cottage.
Fulham have only won one of their last six matches in the Premier League, losing four and conceding 13 goals.
However, Marco Silva’s side will gain confidence from their resilient performance at Anfield in their last outing.
The Cottagers battled back from behind twice to lead against Liverpool before losing 4-3 after late quick-fire strikes from Wataru Endo and Trent Alexander-Arnold.
Fulham are sitting comfortably in 14th position in the table and are eight points above the relegation zone.
Three of Fulham’s victories have come at home this campaign, including their most recent win over Wolves.
They will also take encouragement from the fact they have beaten Forest in seven of their last nine fixtures (losing two) and did the double over them last season.
Forest have lost four of their last five games in the Premier League and are currently one place and two points behind Fulham.

The Tricky Trees recovered well from their demolition at the hands of Liverpool to beat European hopefuls Aston Villa at the City Ground but have since been unable to collect any points in their previous three matches.
Steve Cooper’s side lost 3-2 to West Ham at London Stadium before their eight-match unbeaten streak at home ended with back-to-back defeats against Brighton and Everton.
Forest are six points above the relegation zone but must improve their away form to stay away from the drop zone.
They have only collected a draw in their last four fixtures on their travels, failing to score on three occasions.
Fulham make four alterations to the side that lost 4-3 to Liverpool in their last outing.
It is the most changes that Silva has made from one Premier League match to another, with scorers Tete and Wilson moving onto the bench alongside Ream and Reed.
Castagne comes in at right-back and Adarabioyo appears at centre-back.
Captain Cairney also starts in the midfield, with Willian returning to the team on the right side of the attack.
Forest make five changes to the team that were beaten by Everton at the City Ground.
Origi makes his first start since signing on loan from Milan.
He comes in for Wood up front.
Gibbs-White drops to the bench for only the second time this season, with Hudson-Odoi taking his place on the right.
Boly suffered an injury in the last fixture and is replaced by Felipe, who captains the side.
Finally, Aina is preferred ahead of Aurier at right-back and Dominguez is picked ahead of Yates in the midfield.
Forest have kept just one clean sheet in their last 11 league games against Fulham, a 1-0 win at Craven Cottage in the Championship in April 2022.
Both teams are on the pitch and are ready to get started.
Fulham get this Premier League clash under way.
This is a special match for Fulham winger Willian.
He is just the fourth South American - and first Brazilian player - to make 300 Premier League appearances, along with Antonio Valencia (325), Pablo Zabaleta (303) and Nolberto Solano (302).
Fulham have kept the ball well for the opening few minutes of the game.
Willian holds possession well on the left before sliding it through to Robinson, who wins a corner.
Adarabioyo gets onto the end of the following cross, but he cannot get a good connection on his header.
Diop has the ball in his own half and he looks to switch the play over to the left towards Willian.
However, Aina gets across to head it away against his former side.
Forest have started the game slowly.
The away side keep gifting the ball back to Fulham, who have retained possession well.
Origi has looked isolated up front but has offered a couple of runs forward when his side have had it.
Jimenez drops deep to collect the ball and wins a free-kick off Felipe.
Pereira drills a cross into the box, but Castagne is in an offside position.
Aina drags his side forward and wins a free-kick in a promising position after stepping across Willian, who fouls the right-back.
Hudson-Odoi curls a cross in from the right, but Adarabioyo heads it out.
Jimenez holds play up well before offloading it to Willian.
Pereira springs down the right, but the ball gets stuck under Willian's foot, allowing Sangare to get back and win possession.
Palhinha collects Willian's offload inside from the left and switches a pass over to Iwobi on the right.
The former Everton man drops it off to Pereira, but his cross is blocked by Elanga, who gets back well to help his side.
Forest look to go direct to try and force an attack.
Murillo steps out of the defence and launches a pass down the left to Elanga, but he makes his run slightly too early and is caught offside.
Willian steps over the ball and moves inside before curling a pass over to Iwobi on the right.
He looks to put a cross in the box, but Vlachodimos claims it with ease.
CHANCE! Dominguez collects the ball just past the halfway line and turns in possession.
He sends a pass into the feet of Origi, who manages to get it out of his feet before curling a low shot wide from outside the box.
Willian takes a poor touch inside Forest's box, with the away side rushing away on the counter.
Elanga rushes down the left side of Fulham's box and looks to go past Pereira, but the Brazilian does well to get a tackle in.
Fulham captain Cairney slips just outside the box on the left but manages to poke a pass through to Jimenez.
He gets a shot away from a tight angle, with Vlachodimos getting down to make the save.
Fulham won their first four midweek (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) Premier League games last season, before losing the previous two.
In games played specifically on Wednesdays, the Cottagers are winless in 11 Premier League games (drawing five and losing six) since a 2-1 win against West Ham in January 2014.
They have had plenty of possession in this match, but only one shot on target.
Pereira and Jimenez combine in a tight space just outside Forest's box, with the latter winning a foul off Sangare in a shooting position.
Plenty of Fulham players want to take it.
POST! Willian wants to take the free-kick, but he steps away from it.
Pereira is the only man over it, with the Brazilian whipping it over the wall and against the outside of the post.
The Fulham man wants a corner, but a goal-kick is given.
Fulham are looking to stretch the pitch as much as possible, with Willian on the left and Iwobi on the right.
The hosts are switching the play out to their tricky wingers and are having mixed results.
GOALLL! IWOBI SCORES! 1-0 FULHAM! What a goal from the hosts! Bassey brings the ball out of the defence and plays a pass into the feet of Cairney.
The captain lays it down the left to Willian, who cuts onto his right foot before curling it across to Iwobi.
He gets beyond Toffolo and taps in from close range.
Willian gets an assist on his 300th Premier League appearance.
He shifts possession onto his right foot and curls a low cross into a dangerous area.
He finds the run of Iwobi, who shoots across the goal and into the bottom corner.
Iwobi has scored two goals in his last three matches, as many as he managed in his previous 59 Premier League games.
Murillo is surrounded in the Fulham box.
He gets the ball onto his left foot and blasts a shot over the bar.
GOALLL! JIMENEZ SCORES! 2-0 FULHAM! The Cottagers get their second of the game.
Iwobi collects the ball on the right and sends a pass into Pereira.
He pokes it into the path of Jimenez, who gets into the box and crashes his effort into the net.
Pereira has been a vital part of Fulham's attack this season and does well to get an assist to his name.
He takes a good touch on the edge of the box and finds the run of Jimenez, who finishes clinically.
Jimenez collided with Vlachodimos after scoring.
The Forest goalkeeper needs treatment but will be able to continue.
Forest have won just one of their last 17 Premier League away games (drawing four and losing 12), beating Chelsea 1-0 in September.
In fact, all four of their away points so far this season have come in London (also a 0-0 draw with Crystal Palace).
They will need to stage an almighty comeback if they want to get anything out of this match.
Robinson overlaps Willian on the left and sends a phenomenal low cross into the box.
It looks like Iwobi has another simple finish, but Toffolo gets back to clear it behind for a corner.
Jimenez is playing with confidence after scoring his second goal in four matches.
He does brilliantly to head a long pass forward into the feet of Iwobi, who finds Pereira on the inside.
However, his touch is poor and Forest have it back.
Forest are struggling to get anything out of the game, with Fulham playing as a team.
Dominguez strolls into the opposition's half and has no idea that Jimenez is chasing after him to win back possession.
A loud cheer then goes around Craven Cottage.
There will be four minutes of additional time.
Robinson gains possession inside Fulham's half and surges through the middle of the pitch with the ball before getting tackled.
Willian looks slightly frustrated on the left as he was completely free.
WIDE! Iwobi goes close to adding his second and Fulham's third.
Aina tries to dribble out of danger but slips in possession on the edge of Fulham's box.
Iwobi collects it and sends his shot towards the top corner, with his effort going just wide.
Forest win a late corner after a great run from Hudson-Odoi.
However, Toffolo's cross is cleared away with ease.
HALF-TIME: FULHAM 2-0 NOTTINGHAM FOREST
Fulham are 2-0 ahead at half-time after goals from Iwobi and Jimenez.
Forest struggled to create anything before the break, with Origi going the closest to scoring for the away side.
He collected a pass from Dominguez on the edge of the box and curled a low shot around the post.
The Cottagers dominated from that point onwards.
Iwobi broke the deadlock after a brilliant counter from the hosts.
Cairney found Willian, who sent a low cross into the path of Iwobi for a simple finish.
Fulham added their second just four minutes later.
Pereira slipped in Jimenez, who blasted his shot into the top corner.

events.action: blasted his shot into the top corner

text: Iwobi then went close to adding an excellent third, but he whipped his strike just off target from outside the box.
Fulham have been totally dominant in this match.
They have had eight shots compared to Forest's two and have had 61.7 per cent of the possession.
Their wing play has been excellent, with Willian and Iwobi causing lots of problems.
They have stretched the pitch, with Robinson also overlapping brilliantly down the left to create overloads.
As for Cooper's men, they only created an xG (expected goals) of 0.1.
The Tricky Trees haven't been able to find Origi in the attack enough, with the striker only having 17 touches in his first Forest start in the Premier League.
Gibbs-White was warming up before half-time and will probably come on sooner rather than later.
Cooper has seen enough and has decided to make two changes before the restart.
Sangare struggled in the midfield before the break and is replaced by Yates.
Gibbs-White has been one of Forest's best players since their return to the Premier League and is now coming on.
Dominguez was substituted at half-time in their last away match and makes way again.
Forest get the ball rolling again.
Forest have lost all 66 games that they have played when trailing by two or more goals at half-time.
Cooper will be hoping that his changes will make history off the bench.
Robinson tries to flick a clever ball down the left to Willian, but Felipe gets across and clears it up the pitch.
Fulham have started the half positively.
Elanga does well to get on the end of a loose ball down the left side of the pitch.
He slows down before racing past Cairney, who fouls the Forest man.
Iwobi gets past Elanga with ease down the right and whips an inviting cross into the middle of the box.
However, it goes just over the head of Jimenez and Forest clear it away.
Willian races inside and uses his feet to get past Aina.
The former Chelsea man then lays it into the path of Jimenez, who touches the ball out of his feet and curls a shot across the goal and wide.
GOALLL! JIMENEZ SCORES AGAIN! 3-0 FULHAM! What a moment for Jimenez, who is back to his best.
He gets onto the end of a long ball forward and takes it down with his chest inside the Forest box.
He pushes Aina away, goes past Vlachodimos and backheels his effort into an empty net.
Fulham have alternated between defeat and victory in all six of their Premier League home games this season, beating Wolves 3-2 last time out.
They’ve failed to score in all three defeats while keeping just one clean sheet in these six games.
They have been in complete control of this match, with their fans now cheering every successful pass.
Forest are making another two changes.
Origi made a bright start to the match, but his first start for the club is now over.
Wood takes his place up front.
Danilo has regularly come off the bench this season for Forest and does it again in this match.
Hudson-Odoi is off after a quiet performance on the right.
Fulham are playing the ball around with ease.
Castagne lofts a high cross towards the back of the box towards Willian, who touches it past Aina but cannot get a shot away.
Leno has had a simple game in the Fulham net.
He is yet to face a shot on target in this match and hasn't had to claim a cross into the box.
Willian's 300th Premier League appearance is now over.
He comes off with an assist to his name and is replaced by Wilson, who scored in Fulham's last match.
Jimenez has been fantastic in this game but has a moment to forget as he dribbles the ball straight off the pitch on the right.
His face shows a slight bit of frustration at the loose touch.
Forest are supposed to be chasing this match with Fulham in the lead, but they are yet to have a shot in this half.
Gibbs-White was brought on at half-time to try and alter the match, but he has had just eight touches.
Forest have their first shot of the half.
Aina races down the right and curls a low cross into the path of Wood.
He darts towards the near post but directs his effort wide.
Gibbs-White rushes inside from the left and looks to play a quick pass into the path of Danilo.
However, the ball is too far ahead of the Brazilian, with Leno collecting it.
Elanga bursts down the left side of the pitch before cutting inside with the ball.
He has options around him, but his pass across to Gibbs-White is poor.
Palhinha steps across to make a simple interception.

GOALLL! IWOBI SCORES! 4-0 FULHAM! The hosts score again! The Cottagers keep possession well down the right, with Pereira playing a pass back to Cairney, who slides the ball into Wilson inside the box.
The substitute cuts it across to Iwobi, who taps in for another easy finish.
Wilson is completely unmarked on the right side of the box, with Cairney finding him with a smart pass.
He could shoot from a tight angle but is unselfish and looks for Iwobi instead.
He is free and scores for the second time.
Fulham make two changes in this match.
Robinson is given a rest and is replaced by Ballo-Toure.
Iwobi will not be given the chance to score his hat-trick.
He comes off moments after scoring and is replaced by Cordova-Reid.
Forest make a change in the defence.
Captain Felipe makes his way off, with Niakhate coming on.
Yates is the first player to go into the book after a foul on Cairney.

Fulham have had two players score two or more goals for them in the same Premier League game for the fourth time, after February 2006 v West Brom (Helguson, John), March 2012 v Wolves (Pogrebnyak, Dempsey), and May 2023 v Leicester (Cairney, Willian).
Jimenez has already scored two goals in the match and doesn't look happy that he will not be able to get his third.
Vinicius comes on in his place up front.
Combative midfielder Palhinha is also given a rest.
Lukic is on.
CHANCE! Forest have their first shot on target of the match.
Elanga forces Leno into a sharp stop from a tight angle.
Gibbs-White rushes into the middle of Fulham's half and gets beyond his marker.
He looks to poke a pass down the left, but his attempt is poor and Castagne is there to make the interception.
GOALLLL! CAIRNEY SCORES! 5-0 FULHAM! The captain adds Fulham's fifth goal.
Forest make a mistake in the defence, with Pereira laying the ball into the path of Cairney.
He waits for Vlachodimos to commit one way before shooting past the goalkeeper.
Pereira combines quickly with Cairney and sees that the captain is free on the edge of the box.
His pass is simple but unselfish, with Cairney finishing with composure.
Fulham have scored five goals in a game for the first time since May 8 2023 against Leicester City (winning 5-3).
Ballo-Toure gets to the byline on the left and wins a corner off Niakhate.
Pereira sends it back to Cairney, who recycles possession instead of putting a cross into the box.
There will be five minutes of additional time.
Pereira goes short to Cairney with a corner for a second time in quick succession, with the home fans showing some discontent.
They see more goals in this match and want their side to launch the ball into the box.
Pereira's inswinging corner is cleared to the edge of the box towards Cairney.
He tries to take the ball down and get a shot away, but Mangala gets in front of him and makes a strong tackle.
Leno is now being urged to shoot when he gets on the ball.
FULL-TIME: FULHAM 5-0 NOTTINGHAM FOREST
Jimenez and Iwobi scored twice to help Fulham thrash Forest 5-0 at Craven Cottage.
Origi went close to netting his first Forest goal, but he curled a low shot from outside the box around the post.
Fulham controlled the rest of the match and scored the opening goal in style.
Their quick counter was finished by Iwobi, who got on the end of Willian’s cross from the left to tap in.
The Cottagers then doubled their advantage four minutes later.
Pereira rolled a pass into Jimenez, who thumped his effort into the top corner.

events.action: thumped his effort into the top corner

text: The former Wolves man scored again after the break to net his first brace since January 2020.
Jimenez pushed away Aina and dribbled past Vlachodimos before backheeling his shot into an open goal.
Iwobi then added his second and Fulham's fourth.
Wilson's cutback from the right went straight to him, with Iwobi having the easiest of finishes from close range.
Captain Cairney then scored the final goal to complete the route.
He made the most of a mistake in the Forest defence and curled his strike past Vlachodimos.
Next up, Fulham host West Ham, with Forest travelling to Wolves.
That's all for today, goodbye.
